from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyOtherCurrentAssets(BaseModel):
    """One company's '其他流动资产' (other current assets) value from its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company, as named in the report")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The period covered by the financial report")
    other_current_assets_ending_balance: float | None = Field(description="The ending balance of other current assets, in yuan")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the report containing the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_other_current_assets: list[CompanyOtherCurrentAssets]
